kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Unknown. First used in the Qur'an, with its form seemingly chosen to rhyme with جَالُوت (jālūt, “Goliath”). Historically explained as being from طَوِيل (ṭawīl, “tall”), as Saul is described as being taller than the other Israelites (1 Samuel 10 :23).
g: A king from the Qur'an who is usually considered to be Saul.
